description.value: Demon's within 30 feet of the pit lord gain a bonus to their initiative equal to its Charisma modifier, and a demon who drops to 0 hit points while within 30 feet of the pit lord can make one melee attack before falling unconscious.
The pit lord has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
the pit lord's weapon attacks are magical.
If the pit lord fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

When the pit lord dies, it explodes, and each creature within 30 feet of it must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 ([[/damage 10d6 fire]]) on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion ignites flammable objects in that area that aren't being worn or carried, and it destroys the pit lord's weapons.
The pit lord makes two melee weapon attacks, then can uses its Bellowing Howl action.
Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit:25 ([[/damage 3d10 + 9 slashing]]) + 7 ([[/damage 2d6 fire]])
Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 10ft., up to three targets. Hit:15 ([[/damage 1d12 + 9 slashing]]).

Each creature of the pit lord's choice that can hear it within 120 feet of the pit lord and is aware of it must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the pit lord's Bellowing Howl for the next 24 hours.
Each ally of the pit lord's within 60 feet of it can't be charmed or frightened until the end of its next turn.
The pit lord calls into the depths of the Twisted Nether, summon either one infernal or 2d4 felhunters. They roll and act on their own initiatives.
The pit lord uses its Demonic Command action
The pit lord makes a halberd attack

The pit lord sweeps its tail out. Each creature within 10 feet of the pit lord must succeed on a DC 25 Strength saving throw. On a fail, a creature takes 13 ([[/damage 1d8 + 9 bludgeoning]]) and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature only takes half damage and does not fall prone.
The pit lord uses its Cleave action
